item.text:
The validation gap is in [flipt.cue](/app/internal/cue/flipt.cue): it checks field shapes and bounds but does not check whether rule variants or segments exist. [Validate](/app/internal/cue/validate.go:58) puts CUE issues in a `Result` and returns only a sentinel error, so it also needs the requested single, unwrap-able error interface and location formatting. [validate.go](/app/cmd/flipt/validate.go:58) would need to consume that interface.

Snapshot construction in [snapshot.go](/app/internal/storage/fs/snapshot.go:80) bypasses validation. It rejects missing rule segments during assembly but silently skips missing distribution variants at [line 363](/app/internal/storage/fs/snapshot.go:363). The requested `SnapshotFromFS` and `SnapshotFromPaths` interfaces are absent. The importer creates flags and rules before checking variant references at [importer.go](/app/internal/ext/importer.go:236), which can leave state after a failed import; the exact reason a second run succeeds depends on backend behavior I did not verify.

**Requirement conflict:** all three existing `valid*.yaml` fixtures reference `fromFlipt` or `fromFlipt2` variants that they do not declare. Strict reference checking would reject those exact files, contrary to the stated success requirement. That fixture expectation needs reconciliation before a fix can satisfy both conditions.

Existing `internal/cue` and `internal/storage/fs` tests pass. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md); no project source or tests were changed.
